title: ATOTG
description: Axon Technology Ores That Glow is a texture pack that makes the mod's ores, portal blocks, and certain items glow.
body:
# A texture pack that only works for Axon Technologies. If you want a texture pack  that only changes vanilla ores, check out [V.L.O.G](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/v.l.o.g) (not made by me)
A texture pack that makes Axon Technology ores glow. It uses emmisive textures using Continunity
It changes all the ores, portals, and certain items/blocks that arent ores.
